tokens.name: char
tokens.usage: Burnt-wood brown. Logo ink, dark bands and body text on paper (15.4:1) and birch (11.1:1). The brand's anchor colour; never swap it for pure black on screen.

tokens.name: kerf
tokens.usage: The scorched edge a laser leaves on birch. Draws the burnt-edge keyline around birch panels (edge-kerf) and secondary text on paper (9.5:1) and birch (6.9:1).

tokens.name: birch
tokens.usage: Birch plywood face. Photo mats, feature panels and the stamp disc; text colour on char and band (11.1:1). Text on birch is char or kerf, never maple below 24px (4.46:1).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Light page ground in the Paper theme. Leaf colour in the maple profile picture (6.2:1 on maple).

tokens.name: maple
tokens.usage: Leaf red. The leaf mark, primary buttons and links on paper (6.2:1) and white (6.5:1). A spark, not a flood: never a large background except the profile picture. Never on char (2.5:1); use maple-bright there.

tokens.name: maple-bright
tokens.usage: Leaf red lifted for dark grounds. The leaf in reversed logos and the reversed stamp only (4.3:1 on char). Not for text.

tokens.name: spruce
tokens.usage: Deep blue-green for confirmations (order received, paid). Kept off the red-green axis so it never reads as the opposite of maple.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, order summary, anything that sits on the page. ink reads 15.4:1 / 11.7:1 on it.

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Full-width dark sections: the hero, the how-it-works strip, the footer. One or two per page.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and logo ink on band (11.1:1 light, 12.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headlines on surface and surface-raised (15.4:1 light, 13.2:1 / 11.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hints, captions, sizes and meta text on surface and surface-raised (9.5:1 light, 7.7:1 / 6.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: on-birch
tokens.usage: Text on birch panels in both themes (11.1:1).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between sections and list rows. Carries no meaning, so it may sit under 3:1.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-control borders, 3:1 or more on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links and selected states. As text on surface: 6.2:1 light, 5.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills and links.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text on brand and brand-strong fills (6.5:1 / 8.9:1 light, 5.1:1 / 6.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 13:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmation text and icons, always with a word ("Paid", "Order received"). 6.9:1 light, 6.1:1 dark.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors, always with an icon and a sentence that says how to fix it, because it sits close to brand red. 7.6:1 light, 5.9:1 dark.

families.display: "Alfa Slab One", Rockwell, "Roboto Slab", Georgia, serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero headline, once per page. Drops to display-l under 600px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section headlines; the hero on phones.

styles.name: display-s
styles.usage: Prices and product names on cards. The smallest Alfa Slab One ever goes.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, step titles, form section titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Design your sign on your phone in a couple of minutes.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Pick it up in Sherwood Park, usually within 7 days.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Photo: family name sign in birch
styles.usage: Image captions and fine print. Never for anything a customer must read to order.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to input; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Price to meta; small gutters.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side margin on phones; card text padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Button side padding; grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space between a headline and what it introduces.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop; space between groups in a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs: a crisp cut edge, barely softened.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Birch panels and photo mats.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The stamp, profile pictures and round door sign shapes only.

tokens.name: edge-hairline
tokens.usage: line dividers.

tokens.name: edge-kerf
tokens.usage: The burnt edge: kerf keyline around birch panels, and input and secondary button borders.

tokens.name: edge-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width, drawn 2px outside the element.

tokens.name: shadow-hang
tokens.usage: A sign hung on a wall: under product photos on birch panels only. Nothing else casts a shadow.
